reviews.title: Highly Recommended! After trying several headsets, this is THE BEST for a loud environment.
reviews.comment: Great headset! I tried several before selecting this one. Looked into the specs and features I needed, watched a bunch of review videos, but nothing convinced me as much as trying them in a loud, distracting office. I needed to solve two problems: 1. Office environment too loud, distracting, sometimes I can barely hear myself think, this is WITH regular headphones on, so I needed solid noise cancellation, and 2. I needed a good quality voice isolating mic, with a folding mic boom, that will not pick up other voices and noises like the regular headphones mic did so the caller on the line with me can actually HEAR me and it won't sound like a conference call with everyone else around me. On BOTH counts this headset is incredible, but I'm mostly impressed with how well it voice isolates and mutes all the chaos around me, callers with me detect absolutely nothing. It's very easy to use, battery life is great, instructions for connecting and operating are fairly straightforward. Highly Recommended!
reviews.author: KeeAto

reviews.title: Best headset I've had for WFH set up!
reviews.comment: My husband and I both work from home, and we sit about 10 feet apart. We are also on Teams calls throughout the day. I've gone through several headsets trying to find the right setup to both block what I hear from him and what others I'm talking to can hear in the background (husband, barking dog, town fire whistle...). This has been the best. I can easily turn on the noise cancelling so I can dampen what I hear around me, but more importantly, no one on my calls can hear what is going on around me on my end! These are a comfortable fit, connect seamlessly, charge well with the stand, and are well-made. I highly recommend!  It has made my work day and shared office space SO much better!
reviews.author: SbuxMellie

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.comment: Excellent headset overall, good value for money. Sound quality is great, remains comfortable over long calls due to great fit, noise cancelling works well in a medium-to-high noise office setting, good quality mic, Bluetooth range is better than expected and battery life exceeded my expectations. Carrying case/pouch is a great touch. Recommended.
reviews.author: Jose A Rodrigues D

reviews.title: Extremely satisfied
reviews.comment: Easy to set up. Literally just plug in usb or connect to Bluetooth. It can connect to my phone via Bluetooth and to the computer with the usb at the same time. I received compliments about how clear I sound on the recipients end. It has a mute button but also mutes with microphone swivel function. You can also abound end the call with a button on the headset as well. Comes with a travel case and charger. I bought the one with a charging stand and I am glad I did. I like the simplicity of it, and the clean look. Head set is adjustable, and fits well. On the smallest setting it fits my head (I ave a small head) I Very satisfied. I’ve been using it about a month no complaints yet!
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Great for meetings
reviews.comment: I used to use my AirPod max for meetings but this thing provides much better quality and stable connection. Would recommend for meeting usage for sure.
